narrative.details:
Something evil is brewing in the forests of Teldrassil.  Look long the hills to where the peaceful furbolgs used to dwell.  They have deserted their homes and are amassing under the name of the Gnarlpine tribe.

Only the corruption of wicked Fel Moss could cause such a transformation.  The grells and grellkin have infested the area and are threatening the residents of Shadowglen.

Engage these grells and grellkin, adventurer, and see if they are indeed caught under the enchantment of the wicked Fel Moss.
narrative.objectives: Collect 8 Fel Moss and bring them to Tarindrella.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Your service to the creatures of Shadowglen is worthy of reward, adventurer.

You confirmed my fears, however. If the grells have become tainted by the Fel Moss, one can only imagine what has become of the Gnarlpine tribe of furbolgs who once lived here.

Should you find yourself in Dolanaar, able Champion, seek out the knowledgeable druid, Athridas Bearmantle. He shares our concern for the well being of the forest.
narrative.requestItemsText: Satisfy my suspicions, adventurer. Bring to me 8 Fel Moss.
